description_en: Downgrades the bandwidth of a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 使用DowngradeSmartAccessGateway接口降低智能接入网关实例的带宽
kebab_example: aliyun smartag downgrade-smart-access-gateway --smart-ag-id sag-nylv14tghsk26c00000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --band-width-spec 20 --auto-pay true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DowngradeSmartAccessGateway

parameters.description_en: The ID of the SAG instance.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
The bandwidth of the SAG instance.

*   If the model of the SAG device is **SAG-100WM**, set the bandwidth to **2 to 50 Mbit/s**.
*   If the model of the SAG device is **SAG-1000**, set the bandwidth to **10 to 500 Mbit/s**.
parameters.description_zh:
智能接入网关的带宽。
                                 
- 如果网关设备规格为**SAG-100wm**，带宽取值：**2~50Mbps**。
                                    
- 如果网关设备规格为**SAG-1000**，带宽取值：**10~500Mbps**。
